info.title: Portal Research Foundation API
info.description: P09 same-origin, read-only Journey and Engine Atlas contracts. Browser consumers receive only bounded descriptor and manifest facts. They never receive private Portal URLs, internal principals, engine handles, worker controls, raw source bytes, market rows or a dispatch surface.

get.summary: Read the pinned Research Journey descriptor and P02 inspection cursor

200.description: Pinned descriptor and canonical inspection state

304.description: The private descriptor representation has not changed

get.summary: Read the current or retained historical Engine Atlas manifest

304.description: The private Atlas representation has not changed

ETag.description: Private, representation-specific validator; never a permission or source cursor.

Stage.name: stage
Stage.description: p02-cursor.v2 presentation-only key: the open evidence tab. It never selects, filters or authorizes a resource.

Problem.description: Typed same-origin refusal; no private source/transport/worker fact is disclosed.

codec.description: RF01-B4. Optional for clients deployed before the v2 codec; the server emits it on every read.

CapabilityAxes.description: Exact P04 capability-axis vocabulary. P09 deliberately mirrors it rather than widening any manifest fact.

ClaimDescriptor.description: Exact P04 manifest claim descriptor; it is descriptive and does not authorize a run.

anyOf.description: CG-P04-07: the engine's own meaning of the certification level, and whether certify_result_metadata derives the same level for this contract. A different level is published as such.

EvidenceContract.description: Exact P04 declared evidence envelope. P09 publishes declaration only; it neither writes evidence nor exposes a worker control.

anyOf.description: CG-P04-06: one word derived server-side from published facts (DEFERRED, DEFAULT, EXPERIMENTAL, n/m, LEGACY, SUPPORTED); null when the manifest has no engine facts for the route.

AtlasSourceLocator.description: Where a fact is stated in the pinned engine package: file, line range, the file digest carried by the wheel RECORD, and a string that occurs in that range.

anyOf.description: CG-P04-04: per_fold_decay feeds OOS into selection; per_fold_causal withholds it until after selection is frozen; global reads it back retrospectively (USED) or only reports it (NOT_USED); mode_5 has no held-out window.

required_request_fields.description: CG-P02-02: requested-spec fields this mode × schedule needs before preflight admits it (e.g. walk_forward.inner).

release_default.description: Exact decimal string; null when the release leaves it unset.

terms.description: CG-P04-07: what each objective term means, citing the engine lines that compute it.

weights.description: CG-P04-07: release-default selection weights of modes 2-5 (WalkForwardConfig defaults), each citing where the engine applies it.

facts.description: RF02-B1. Per mode × schedule engine facts, each with a source locator in the pinned QuantBT release. Optional for a manifest written before the facts existed; a fact the source does not state is NOT_PUBLISHED with a reason.

train_window.description: CG-P08-02: the manifest-owned rolling train width (requested-spec v2 walk_forward.train_window).

temporal_guards.description: CG-P02-02: label horizon, purge and embargo in bars (requested-spec v2).

inner_folds.description: CG-P02-02: nested inner folds for mode_1_decay × per_fold_causal (requested-spec v2 walk_forward.inner).

config_digest.description: CG-P10-01. sha256 of the canonical browser-visible release configuration (release_id, trial_ceiling, optimizer_defaults, submission_constraints, walk_forward_options). A New Run form sends it unchanged as requested_spec.client.config_digest; the browser never computes it.

walk_forward_options.description: RF02-B2. The walk-forward values New Run may offer, each with the Portal's admission; preflight admits exactly the ADMITTED ones. Optional for a manifest written before it existed.

AtlasResolvedBackend.description: CG-P04-06: the backend the pinned constructor resolves with no caller override. SPEC_DEPENDENT means the constructor needs a typed specification first; its support matrix lists backends per specification.

AtlasSupportMatrix.description: CG-P04-06: pass-through of the engine's public support-matrix function (arbitrage_support_matrix or nautilus_support_matrix).

AtlasRouteParams.description: CG-P04-06: per requested-spec route_params field, the P02 value list next to the engine's own vocabulary; accepted_by_engine is their exact intersection.

AtlasRouteEngineFacts.description: CG-P04-06: route facts read from the pinned QuantBT wheel, each with a source locator. Descriptive; never run admission.

AtlasPreflightLimits.description: CG-P08-05: ceilings P08 enforces server-side, each naming its source. None is an engine limit.
